name: Resting in Pieces
summary: On Fenris Isle, Resting in Pieces begins with Alaric's animated, severed head. He asks to be carried across Fenris Keep to an unmarked grave near the stables, where the rest of his remains lie.

sections.title: A Bodyguard Betrayed
sections.body: Alaric once served as Thule Ravenclaw's chief servant and personal bodyguard at Fenris Keep in Silverpine Forest. Thule was a powerful mage aligned with the Scourge. When the Plague of Undeath swept through the region, he promised his sorcery would shield Alaric from it. Instead, the ward trapped Alaric in endless agony and undeath, with his awareness intact in his severed parts.

sections.title: Plaything of the Rot Hides
sections.body: Thule created the rot hide gnolls by infecting local packs with necromantic decay, then turned against his own bodyguard. He cut off Alaric's head and threw it to the savage gnolls as a diversion. The rot hides dragged Alaric's body to a shallow, hastily dug grave outside the keep's stables. They kept his speaking head as a grim plaything until an outsider intervened.

sections.title: Reuniting the Pieces
sections.body: The hastily dug grave near the stables holds Alaric's headless torso. When his severed head is brought there, his remains are reunited. Thule's curse still binds Alaric to undeath, but having his parts restored brings him a bitter measure of relief.

faq.answer: Alaric served as Thule Ravenclaw's chief servant and personal bodyguard at Fenris Keep. Thule's spell, supposedly meant to shield him from the Plague of Undeath, instead bound him to eternal unlife.
Thule Ravenclaw beheaded Alaric after completing his experiments to create the rot hide gnolls. He threw Alaric's severed, conscious head to the gnolls as a plaything.
Alaric's body lies in an unmarked, shallow grave dug in haste on Fenris Isle, in Fenris Keep's courtyard near the stable buildings.

faq.q: What are the rot hide gnolls?
faq.answer: The rot hide gnolls are Fenris Isle's local gnoll packs, transformed into rotting horrors touched by undeath through Thule Ravenclaw's necromantic experiments.
Thule Ravenclaw is a human wizard and Scourge necromancer who seized Fenris Keep in the middle of Lake Lordamere. He uses it as a laboratory to corrupt the gnolls and spread the Scourge's influence.

faq.q: What happens after you find the grave?
faq.answer: After his remains are reunited, Alaric helps you find a hidden niche containing a powerful wand. You can return it to Dalaran's Magus Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

angles.text: As a Forsaken champion, you will recognize Thule Ravenclaw's treacherous spellcasting as one of the cruel horrors Scourge-aligned sorcerers inflict across Lordaeron.
As a mage, you can see how Thule twisted a defensive ward into an inescapable curse of severed undeath. His spell shows the harm arcane magic can suffer when necromancy corrupts it.
